name: What maintenance is required for traffic noise reduction windows?

mainEntity.name: What maintenance is required for traffic noise reduction windows?

acceptedAnswer.text: Maintenance for traffic noise reduction windows is similar to that of standard windows. Regular cleaning of the glass surfaces and frames is recommended to keep them looking their best. It's also advisable to periodically check the seals around the window edges to ensure they remain intact and effective for both soundproofing and weather resistance. Avoid using abrasive cleaners on the glass or frames. Proper care helps maintain their performance and longevity.
acceptedAnswer.description: Maintenance involves regular cleaning of glass and frames, and periodically checking seals to ensure continued soundproofing and weather resistance.
